Verdict Label: LDO's standard V0.2-S1 frame kit; pre-cut/tapped aluminum, blind joints, includes top-hat extrusions.
Name: Voron V0.2-S1 Frame Kit
Dimensions: 120x120x120mm build volume, 1515 extrusion; includes 120mm top-hat extrusions
Description: LDO aluminum frame kit for the Voron V0.2-S1 (120x120x120mm build volume). Blind-joint 1515 extrusions, pre-cut and tapped; includes 120mm top-hat extrusions. Requires a Kirigami bed or metal bed mount.

Verdict Label: $5.99 hardware kit for a popular free anti-vibration foot design.
Name: Hula V1 Anti-Vibration Feet
Description: Omnidirectional self-aligning anti-vibration foot by ThrutheFrame; decouples the printer from the table and dampens horizontal XY vibration. Printed parts are PETG with 95A TPU dampeners/air pads plus an F8-22M thrust bearing. The Fabreeko listing is the hardware kit only - printed parts are free STLs.

Verdict Label: Precision-machined steel mounts for the Hula K3 system - preorder with a ~2-month wait, motors and hardware not included.
Name: Hula Motor Mounts
Description: Set of 4 precision-machined motor mounts for the Hula system on the Annex Engineering K3, made from the same material as the linear rails for a matching look, better heat dissipation and superior strength over printed parts. Made for long-shaft motors - couplers are not compatible. Motors and mounting hardware NOT included. Usable standalone. PREORDER: period ends Sun Nov 15, 2026 11:59pm EST; ~60-day delivery.

Verdict Label: $12.50 - genuine VzBoT design, fits Goliath/Crazy/Dragon/V6/Sherpa Mini/Micro
Name: Printhead Bracket
Description: Genuine VzBoT-team authorized CNC aluminium printhead bracket for VzBoT 330 and Vz235 printers, with interchangeable adapter brackets for Goliath/Crazy/Dragon, V6, Sherpa Mini and Sherpa Micro hotends/extruders.

Verdict Label: $16.50 - VzBot 235 AWD only; 330 owners need updated extrusions first
Name: Long-Shaft Motor Mount
Description: CNC-machined aluminium AWD long-shaft motor mount designed for the VzBot 235, extending the motor support point to better distribute radial loads for smoother high-speed printing; for LDO-42STH48-2804AH(S40R)/Kraken motors.

Verdict Label: Complete V0.1-to-V0.2 upgrade (extrusions, panel, fan); only useful if you already own a V0.1.
Name: V0.1 to V0.2 Upgrade Kit
Dimensions: Adds 1515 extrusions 4x 200mm + 4x 100mm; V0.2 frame is 120x120x120mm build volume
Description: Complete kit to upgrade a Voron V0.1 to V0.2: original LDO 1515 extrusions (4x 200mm, 4x 100mm), bottom acrylic panel, black nickel-plated screws and an LDO 24V 3010 fan.

Name: SimpleCore Redux Frame Kit
Description: Cut Misumi HFSB5-2020 extrusions, black anodized, for the SimpleCore Redux frame. Price: C$166.22 regular converted at ×0.70.

Verdict Label: Full-length steel backers for the K3 crossed gantry - big stiffness gain, but needs a Hula-clearance toolhead.
Name: Hula Backers
Description: Ultra-wide steel rail backers for the Annex Engineering K3 crossed X/Y gantry rails, made from the same steel as the linear rails so they expand/contract together. Full length of the axis with integrated mounting to the XY joints; full set for X and Y with rail-mounting screws. Requires a new toolhead designed for the extra clearance (Hula Toolhead kit or MathematicalPotato toolhead v2). Rails, carriages and toolhead parts NOT included. PREORDER: ends Sun Nov 15, 2026 11:59pm EST; ~60-day delivery.

Verdict Label: $135.20 - full AWD conversion kit, for Voron users chasing high acceleration
Name: AWD Mount
Description: CNC-machined aluminum alloy AWD mount kit for the VCProjects LDO_AWD upgrade, adding extra drive motors to the X/Y axes of Voron V2.4 and Trident printers for higher acceleration and torque; optimized for LDO high-performance long-shaft motors.

Verdict Label: About $3.50 per piece
Name: Idler Spacer 14mm
Description:
Precision EN AW-6060 aluminum idler spacer (Distanzbolzen) — 14mm. Drop-in replacement for printed or stock idler spacers on the XY axis idler stack. Machined to tighter tolerances than printed alternatives, reducing belt path slop and potential VFA. CNC-machined in Austria by Spannsysteme, sold in EU via BRS Engineering.

Price basis: Aluminium Spacer 14mm (Idler Stack) at BRS Engineering (US store), regular price.

Verdict Label: Stock-style rubber feet for Voron V2.4/Trident builds.
Name: Amplifier Feet
Description: Amplifier feet used in Voron V2.4 R2 and Trident builds. Black rubber feet with a metal insert/washer (confirmed from Fabreeko product photos); guitar-amplifier-style feet per Voron builder accounts.

Verdict Label: LDO-made K3 frame, tapped and drilled per BOM; the standard frame for an Annex K3 build.
Name: K3 Frame
Description: LDO-made Annex K3 frame kit: 2020 aluminum extrusions, cut, tapped and drilled per the K3 BOM. Frame kit only - hardware, fasteners and panels sold separately.

Verdict Label: Cheap ($14.99) fastener/bearing/heatset kit that brings an LDO Trident up to R2 spec; no extrusions included.
Name: Trident R2 Upgrade Kit
Description: LDO parts kit to bring an existing Trident kit up to R2 spec: fasteners, M5 shims, 2020 roll-in nuts, brass heatset inserts, F695-2RS bearings, foam tape and PTFE tube. No extrusions included.

Verdict Label: Cheap in-stock mild-steel backers for the K3 frame rails.
Name: K3 Extrusion Backers
Description: Set of 4 mild-steel backers, 1.9mm thick, for use on the back side of the frame-mounted rails of an Annex K3. Tumbled and processed with a corrosion-inhibitor treatment.

Verdict Label: About $29–36
Name: 3030 Corner Joining Plate
Description:
Precision EN AW-7075 aluminum corner joining plate for 3030-profile printers (RatRig V-Core 3 and V-Core 4). Replaces or supplements stock printed/plastic corner connections for improved frame rigidity. 118×118×19mm, CNC-machined in Austria by Spannsysteme. Sold in EU via BRS Engineering (exclusive Spannsysteme reseller).

Price basis: Aluminium 3030 Joining Plate Bottom, Silver raw, at BRS Engineering (US store), regular price.

Verdict Label: About $22–29
Name: Diagonal Frame Brace
Description:
Precision EN AW-7075 aluminum diagonal frame brace for 3030-profile printers. 195×30×19mm. Triangulates corner connections to reduce racking and frame flex — directly reduces ringing artifacts at higher print speeds. Fits all printers using 3030 extrusion profile. CNC-machined in Austria, sold in EU via BRS Engineering.

Price basis: Aluminium 2020/3030 Diagonal Support, Silver Raw, at BRS Engineering (US store), regular price.

Verdict Label: About $29–36
Name: Frame Handle
Description:
Ergonomic CNC-machined EN AW-7075 aluminum frame handle. 192×50×18mm. Mounts to 2020 or 3030 extrusion profiles. More rigid and durable than printed plastic handles — won't flex or creep under repeated load. Functional quality-of-life upgrade for enclosed printers moved frequently. CNC-machined in Austria, sold in EU via BRS Engineering.

Price basis: Aluminium Handle Ergo, Silver raw, at BRS Engineering (US store), regular price.

Verdict Label: $65 - CNC handle + frame support, stiffens the machine and replaces plastic handle
Name: Handle Support Kit
Description: CNC aluminum alloy kit in two parts for VzBoT printers: a support that braces the frame for stability and a metal handle that replaces the plastic part. The design is provided by the VzBoT team.

Verdict Label: Frame-only kit for a niche high-temp printer ($174.99); carbon X tube and rails not included, and the project has since moved to a V2 redesign.
Name: Valkyrie Frame Kit
Dimensions: Frame extrusions X 420, Y 480, Z 750mm; approx 420x480x750mm frame, 2020/2040 extrusion
Description: HoneyBadger frame kit for the Viking 3D Valkyrie high-temperature printer: black Mitsumi-profile 2020/2040 extrusions cut, drilled and tapped to the BOM, plus brackets. Carbon X tube (410mm) and linear rails not included. A portion of the sale supports Viking 3D / Project Valkyrie.

Verdict Label: Beta 2020-extrusion upgrade kit for the Rook - may arrive missing minor hardware.
Name: Rook 2020 Frame Add On
Description: Upgrade kit converting a Rook to 2020 aluminum extrusion for added rigidity and speed. Beta release - may be missing minor things like T-nuts or screws to complete the build.

Verdict Label: Mild-steel backers for the K3 cross rails, screws included.
Name: K3 Rail Backers
Description: Set of 2 mild-steel backers for use on the cross rails of an Annex K3. Includes 22 M3x6 screws. Tumbled and processed with a corrosion-inhibitor treatment. Designed by MathematicalPotato, based on Cbon's original idea.

Verdict Label: The standard LDO V2.4 frame kit; pre-cut/tapped 2020 extrusions in all three sizes.
Name: Voron V2.4 Frame Kit
Dimensions: 250x250x250mm build volume (smallest size), 2020 extrusion; also sold in 300 and 350mm
Description: LDO 2020 aluminum frame kit for the Voron V2.4, in 250/300/350mm sizes. Pre-cut and tapped extrusions; priced on the 250mm variant.

Verdict Label: LDO frame kit for the compact Micron 160/180; solid kit but for a niche printer.
Name: Micron 160/180 Frame Kit
Description: LDO frame kit for the Micron 160/180 compact CoreXY printer. Pre-cut aluminum extrusions; 160mm and 180mm build-volume variants.

Verdict Label: HoneyBadger pre-cut/tapped frame for the Salad Fork 150/160; $99.99 list price (on sale at $49.99 at time of check).
Name: Saladfork 150/160 Frame Kit
Description: HoneyBadger pre-cut and tapped aluminum frame kit for the PrintersForAnts Salad Fork 150/160. Available in 4 colours.

Verdict Label: Pack of 10 aluminium plates to reinforce 2020 frames.
Name: 2020 Extrusion L & T Plates
Dimensions: 60mm x 60mm x 4mm thick, M5 holes, 20mm spacing; pack of 10
Description: Aluminum plates to reinforce 2020 extrusion and frames. Available in T and L styles, sold in packs of 10.
